entities.title: GDScript tests
entities.summary: Headless Godot scripts: the rules against perft counts, the text formats, and a render of every piece.
entities.purpose: test_rules.gd and test_formats.gd run as SceneTree scripts (npm run test:godot) and quit with status 1 on any failure. pieces_shot.gd renders the piece models in a row for docs/screens/23-pieces.png; it is a tool for looking, not a test that fails.
boundaries: The Web export leaves this folder out (exclude_filter in export_presets.cfg).
What the two tests check is recorded in godot/chess/.dev/verification.json and godot/scripts/.dev/verification.json.
